imitation_frequency: 8 sequences x 64 target steps, once on first actor minibatch per rollout
imitation_context_steps: full frozen-core history from episode start
optimizer_transition: restore actor Adam, critic weights/Adam, fixed exploration and actor sampling RNG; reset physical episodes; critic sample shuffle restarts from declared seed
recurrent_carry: exact: upstream weights frozen; retain actual live neural state

reward.timing: sum of reward rates times dt, then one failure penalty at termination

timescales.interpretation: Trace decay is not a hard horizon; the critic bootstraps later returns

policy_update_transition.scope: Same limit in sampled/analytic early stops and backtracking acceptance; PPO clip and actor learning rate unchanged
policy_update_transition.optimizer: Retain actor/critic weights and Adam moments

evaluation_schedule: quarter, midpoint, final; measured training time excludes physical evaluation
budget_rule: fixed rollouts replace the seconds stop; actual training wall time measured
